prompt:
Create one landscape PNG raster illustration, native approximately 16:9 (about 1672 x 941). Friendly, warm, clear abstract hand-drawn comic style matching SkillPilot science learning illustrations: soft cream/pale blue background, rounded dark-blue outlines, a few generous colorful shapes and calm composition. Scientifically sound, never photorealistic, never sterile technical CAD. Main idea and critical details must remain clear at 360px total displayed width, and at 680px. No tiny letters, decorative writing, equations, logos, watermark, caption or textual labels. Use large motifs, sufficient white space. This is an author candidate, not quality approval. 
Actual bilingual learning-goal context (do not typeset this): Artbildungsmechanismen erklären — Die lernende Person kann allopatrische vs. sympatrische Artbildung erläutern. / Explain speciation mechanisms — The learner can explain allopatric vs. sympatric speciation.
Scene: Illustrate two distinct speciation mechanisms as two equally large simple horizontal scenes. Upper scene: one initial population of small green birds at left; a broad geological ridge or river forms between two habitats, isolating two populations which subsequently have visibly different simple plumage (one green, one violet), with wide clear generational progression arrows. Lower scene: in one uninterrupted habitat with no mountain/river/geographical divider, birds use two different large host plants, with two clearly grouped populations which eventually have different simple plumage. Convey reproductive divergence as a long-term model, not instant color change or separate species merely because two colors exist. Use large motifs, just a few birds per group, keep the two processes visually separate. Do not use crosses, misleading pedigree, genetic helix, numbers or words. No suggestion that any two geographic groups always must become species.
